# [TASK] Clean up SonarLint findings in movie-service/media-service application.yml

## Task
User's IDE (SonarLint + vscode-spring-boot) flagged real findings while reviewing #90: 2 SonarLint `secrets:S6694` warnings (hardcoded MongoDB password in media-service and movie-service `application.yml`) and an unknown-property warning (`management.tracing.sampling.probability` in movie-service, not on the classpath since distributed tracing (#42) isn't implemented yet).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Confirmed the flagged credentials (`admin123`/`redis123`/`minioadmin123`) are the same local-dev-only defaults docker-compose.yml itself uses, not a real leaked secret
- [x] Mongo password: removed the hardcoded `admin:admin123` default from both services' `MONGODB_URI` instead of suppressing the finding (config-service's `.env` still supplies the real credentialed URI for normal local dev). The `secrets:S6694` exclusion in build.gradle stays in place for `redis123`, which is still a hardcoded default in movie-service.
- [x] Removed the dead `management.tracing.sampling.probability` block from movie-service's application.yml — it has zero effect with no micrometer-tracing dependency on the classpath anywhere in the repo yet; #42 will add it back for real when tracing is implemented
- [x] movie-service's test suite still green after the removal (122/122)
